teaser: At six in the morning, the airport gate fills before the desk agent even sits down, and you are scanning the room for who looks lost before anyone has asked you to. You carry life path 6, the number of the one who notices and tends, crossed with an INFJ's instinct to see what a stranger needs before they say it. Other sixes rest once the obvious gap is filled. Other INFJs keep their noticing private. In you the two habits double down on each other: the care goes outward and the seeing goes inward, so what others call thoughtfulness feels, from inside, like a duty nobody assigned you.
